class.name: NNArea3DSearchSpace
class.brief_description: Search space containing all [Area3D] nodes currently overlapping a given [Area3D].
class.description: Use when you want an NQS query to search nearby 3D trigger areas (such as pickups, cover zones, or hazards) overlapping [member area3d]. Physics bodies are not included.

members.member: The [Area3D] whose overlapping [Area3D] nodes form the candidate list.
